method: Three fresh deterministic seeds. 5/5/5/5 Bladesmith, no resource, level or unlock grants. Only RNG initialization varies. Public game commands for all policy actions; read-only previews choose useful equipment. Active attention checks every 7 seconds, matching the manual mining cooldown. Each run has the same 60-minute active preparation per seed, then two hours of active attention, 5-minute visits, 15-minute visits or no actions. Automation upgrades are bought and set when affordable: target 2 useful equipment, target 12 bronze ingots, reserve 1 input and 10 gold. Non-active intervals use offline simulation. Results are policy-specific, not a full campaign estimate.
